title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Request for Instruction on Whether a Bank Can Unilaterally Unfreeze Property When the Account Name and Number Do Not Match the Court Freeze Order

articles.content_en:
(Revised by the Decision on, among others, Eighteen Enforcement-Related Judicial Interpretations)
Jiangxi Higher People's Court:
We have received your request, No. [1996] 6 of the Jiangxi Higher People's Court's Research Office. Upon study, our reply is as follows:

A People's Court's adoption of freezing measures on property upon a party's application is a power conferred upon the People's Court by the Civil Procedure Law of China, and no organization or individual shall obstruct such measures. After the People's Court has completed the freezing procedures on the property, if a bank discovers that the frozen account name does not match the account number, the bank shall proactively raise the existing issue with the court for the court to make a correction, and shall not unfreeze the account on its own. If losses are caused by improper self-unfreezing, the bank shall bear corresponding legal liability depending on the degree of its fault.

This is our reply.
